task.title: Fix round 1: explorer test strength (F-011, F-014, F-015, F-016, F-017, F-018)
task.description:
Six findings of review round 1 about the tests of the Metaproject explorer: 26 mutants of MetaprojectView.tsx, useExplorerNavigation.ts and App.tsx survive, so the behaviour they stand for is pinned by no assertion. Each finding is in `fix_context.review_feedback`; the full text is in findings.json and every mutant (file:line, anchor, replacement) in research-evidence/mutation-1-compact.txt. Task T17 has just changed the same production files (results/T17.result.json says what), so some anchors have moved. The task is done when every line below holds, the two test files and the type check pass, and nothing outside the owned files changed.

F-011. The RetainedView test passes one value for both props, so `hidden={!visible}` can become `hidden={!active}` unnoticed (A1); App.tsx passes two different values when Settings is open over the work view. F-014. No test restores a scroll position, and the history cap, the same-route guard, the content reset and the switchView guard are unpinned (N1 to N5). F-015. The AC13 test never varies Direction and runs protocol 1 only (V1, V30). F-016. The “+N more” wiring — open the panel and reveal Relationships — is driven by no test (V8, V8b). F-017. Ten gates T8 added survive deletion (V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V13, V14, V15, V17). F-018. The AC16 guards and the settled AC12 state “No Wiki page matches …” are unpinned (V9, V10, V11, V12, V16, V31); the AC12 test checks the in-flight state only.

Finish line: `scratch_check.py mutants --ids A1 --tests src/App.dom.test.tsx` and `--ids N1,N2,N3,N4,N5,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7,V8,V8b,V9,V10,V11,V12,V13,V14,V15,V16,V17,V30,V31 --tests src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx` report each mutant as killed. For a mutant the tool reports as invalid because T17 moved its anchor, your result names the line that now carries that behaviour and the test that pins it. For a mutant no DOM test can kill, it says why (an equivalent mutant, or behaviour only a layout engine shows). A test added here asserts what a user or a caller can observe — rendered text, roles, the requests the explorer sends, a callback's arguments — not the wording of the source. The production files are owned so that a test can be given a seam it needs; a change of behaviour in them is a `behavior_changes` entry, and a real defect a new test exposes is reported, with the test, before it is fixed.

Scope freeze: fix the findings named here and nothing else. Anything else you notice goes into `noticed_not_touched`; a choice the plan's state x event matrix does not decide goes into `behavior_changes` with `needs_operator: true` and its alternatives. A reviewer's `suggested_fix` is a hypothesis: reproduce the finding first, check the suggestion against the matrix, and say in `notes` where your fix diverged from it or where a finding did not reproduce. Existing tests are not weakened or deleted to make room for a fix.

acceptance_criteria: AC10: Explorer state survives leaving the work view: in the browser dev build, after selecting a node in Graph with a non-empty query and the panel open, switching to Flows and back shows the same view, query, selection, filters, open panel and an available Back button. [verify: judged]

AC11: Back steps through in-view navigation: after selecting nodes A, then B, then C in Graph, Back shows B and Back again shows A; typing in the search field adds no history entries. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx`]

AC12: "Find a Wiki page" for a node with no matching page shows, in the article area, an empty state that names the searched text, and renders no wiki article. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx`]

AC13: The Wiki view's relationships read does not depend on Graph filter state: with Graph depth set to 2 and a relationship type unticked, the neighbours request issued in Wiki mode has depth 1, direction "both" and every non-symbol relationship kind. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx`]

AC16: A wiki link whose target is not among the loaded nodes is resolved with one lookup read and opens the target; when no node has that path, a visible message names the unresolved path; a percent-encoded href and an href with a leading "/" resolve to the right repository path. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx`]

AC17: In Graph mode the relationship list is rendered in the details panel and not under the canvas; filter controls carry human-readable labels; `defines` and `calls` are disabled with a stated reason when the catalog reports no symbol layer; the list header shows "shown of total" from `catalog.counts` instead of the "Catalog is limited" banner; the selected list row is scrolled into view when the selection changes; while relationships for a new selection load, the previous graph stays rendered and is marked busy. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx`]
AC19: The desktop app type-checks and its whole test suite passes. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test src`]
